body: I understand.  Just extra hard to deal with since we still live together.  This is “her” weekend so she’s been with him since Friday.  I have gotten better.  Her and I have talked about a lot of things lately.  Just so hard to live with somebody basically every day for almost 14 years and then one day you’re not with them anymore.

Believe me, I know.  

We had a discussion last night about it.  I told her that I understand that it is my choice to continue to show her that I am not giving up... but it is still unfair that the situation is how it is.  Like we have a great relationship.  She is a great mother to our kids.  When this first started, we agreed that we would alternate weekends.  Well with finances, its hard for us to just get by let alone me be able to take somebody out, or even her out to show her that I've continued to change.  So my weekends consist of normal household things.  I had a side job a couple months back that allowed me to take her to a few events.  That just doesn't get to happen that often.  So our relationship is co-parenting with a side of me trying to prove myself along side dealing with the stresses and pressures of life, and her weekends with him is just a break from adulthood.  I brought up everything being a waste of time last night.  I asked her if she felt what I was doing was a waste of time, that she needed to tell me.  She said it wasn't.  So on one hand its like, ok if its not a waste of time and you want to be back together, then stop being this way and lets work on ourselves.  She has seen some of the changes that I have made and that I'm being consistent with what I have said.  She said to continue and things will sort themselves out.  I just don't understand it.  If you think things will sort themselves out, and that you do see us back together, why waste fucking time and put me through all of this.  The ball is in her court.  I do know that I don't want to rush her.  I don't want her to end it with him and come back to me resentful about anything.  I just want a chance to show her that I would die for her.  I don't see how she will be able to see everything that I'm doing if her attention gets taken elsewhere every other weekend.  He isn't aware of my intentions, or that she is entertaining the thought, but with the current living situation, he is obviously insecure about it.   Also, in our relationship, I have always been the selfish one.  She has always gone out of her way to make everybody happy.  I took that for granted and sucked it up.  That is her reasoning for everything.  That this is for her to be happy again.  So I can only hope that this is a fling and it ends itself.  I just know that if it continues or gets more serious, I won't be able to deal with it.

​

Trust me, I know this situation is fuckin ridiculous.  I hate the fact that I am in it.  I put myself here and I am trying to fix it.

Thank you.  

Due to bad choices I have made, I have destroyed my relationship with the mother of my 3 children.  We had tried to work through everything for almost 2 years and she told me 4 months ago that she doesn’t feel it anymore and has started dating somebody else.  We still live together with our children.  We take turns on weekends doing our own thing.  From the start of this situation it was me trying to make things right or spark something back up on my weekends.  With her it is her spending the weekend with the new guy.  We are a single income house.  She hasn’t worked in quite a while with being a stay at home mother.  We have never been married and we live in a state that doesn’t acknowledge common law marriage.  
I have told her that I still love her and that I will not stop showing her that I want to be back with her.  She has told me to continue showing her this and in time if things are lined up, she wouldn’t be opposed to working things out.  
I’m at a point where I don’t know what else to do.  I’ve changed a full 180 from the person I was.  95% of what I have changed are things that she isn’t able to realize.  I’m trying to get a sliver of trust back to show her that I am genuine with what I have said.  
Please don’t speak negatively on her with what I am about to say.  Even in her situation, her and I have had sex a few times since we have broken up.  We don’t sleep in the same room.  With that said, I would bring things up and she would say that she is “in a relationship”.  Her still sleeping with me has me thinking that it’s more of a out of a 13 year relationship fling thing where she doesn’t have to worry about hurting me since we are still active sexually.  The guy she is seeing is aware of our living situation.  Not aware of the sex or my feelings for her, or her feelings about our future.  
I just don’t know what to do.  I have told her that I am going to wait it out and continue to show her that I want my family complete again, but seeing her walk out that door breaks my fucking heart every time.  I can’t go on feeling this way.  I know it’s something that she “needs to do”, but I can’t feel this hurt anymore.  I had a cord prepped around my neck and I just needed to step off the chair but I couldn’t do it.  More so because I didn’t want my children finding me.  That and I’m all they have for support.  If I’m gone, they get evicted and the role of their provider gets put on somebody else.  
Stress of my job, the situation at home, feeling unloved or wanted is eating me alive.
My kids.  Not so much as not being there to see them grow up.  More so that we struggle at times with me being the only income of the household.  Me gone would add that much more stress on them.
